title: Morphisms of decent Noetherian algebraic spaces factor through the residual space at a point

standard_prerequisites.name: Residual space
standard_prerequisites.use: The closed subspace t({x}) with its induced structure.

standard_prerequisites.name: Universally bounded fibres over the residual space
standard_prerequisites.use: The fibre of U -> X over the residual space is finite.

core_obligations: The residual space t({x}) -> X is a closed immersion with a single point over x.
Any morphism from a scheme locally of finite type whose image is the singleton {x} factors uniquely through t({x}) -> X.
Uniqueness: two factorizations agree on the underlying topological map; the scheme is reduced onto the residual space.
difficulty_reason: A factorization lemma; the uniqueness argument over the reduced residual space is the content.
